D6E2.Settings.SecondEdition.Options.seco: Additional Skill modules
Each optional Skill module adds 2D to the character-creation Skill budget (Second Edition p. 20). Enter only modules actually used by this campaign.
Use Skill Specialization & Advanced Skills
Enable the optional Advanced Skill and Specialization structures from Second Edition pp. 96-99.
Use Module: Perks, Flaws & Talents
Enable native Second Edition feature creation accounting and typed feature services (pp. 101-129).
Use Module: Troubles & Assets
Enable Trouble and Asset invocation, Hero Point transactions, and GM-owned twice-per-session resets (pp. 130-131).
Use Module: Pips
Enable +1 and +2 Die Code modifiers, split-die character creation, and sequential pip advancement (Second Edition pp. 94-95). Core Second Edition otherwise uses whole dice.
Use Module: Chases
Enable the scene-persistent opposed chase tracker with Distance, capture, escape, and Exceptional Success shifts (Second Edition pp. 73-74).
Use Module: Environments
Enable GM-authoritative cold, heat, poisonous-air, and drowning checks with persistent printed effects (Second Edition pp. 77-78).
Use Module: No Dodge Defense
Replace personal ranged Dodge defenses with the printed point-blank, short, medium, long, and long-range-dodging difficulties while retaining Parry (Second Edition p. 94).
Remove Stunned
Remove the Stunned level and make Wounded the first normal damage level (Second Edition p. 89).
Remove Wounded
Remove the Wounded level, making Stunned the first normal damage level and Mortally Wounded the next (Second Edition p. 89).
Use Killing Blows
A personal target dies immediately when Brawn resistance totals less than half Damage; one Hero Point may be spent to survive (Second Edition p. 90).
Cap Brawn + Armor at 6D
Cap personal Brawn-plus-Armor resistance pools at 6D before rolling; relative Scale remains a separate modifier (Second Edition p. 90).
Equipment era
Select one campaign equipment family from Second Edition pp. 79-85. The base system supplies typed schemas and provenance only; licensed packages may register actual catalogs.
Advancement strategy
Select exactly one automated Second Edition advancement module: Experience Points, Milestone rewards, or GM-approved Narrative arcs (Second Edition pp. 86-93).

D6E2.Settings.TyfusiusHomebrew.Options.t: Shift every thrown-explosive range boundary by one meter for each Strength pip above or below 2D. No boundary can fall below zero.
A printed grenade range assumes Strength 2D. Strength 3D has three extra pips, so every boundary moves 3 meters farther. Strength 1D has three fewer pips, so every boundary moves 3 meters closer. Mark a Weapon as Thrown explosive and enter its printed Short start, Short end, Medium end, and Long end.
Printed ranges 3–4 / 7 / 12 become 6–7 / 10 / 15 at Strength 3D. At Strength 1D they become 0–1 / 4 / 9; Point Blank is empty and a throw at 0 meters counts as Short.
